role: Classify one uncertain local commit observation from either a directly validated ledger or a receiver-pinned, builder-validated snapshot, without resubmitting the candidate.

required: one selected state carrier: trusted local ledger or canonical snapshot
for a snapshot, a receiver-selected SHA-256 pin of its exact bytes
snapshot_bound_fields: optional exact transition and stored result

outputs.StoredCommitted: The selected valid carrier binds the exact request and candidate and contains the structurally checked stored result.
outputs.ProvenUncommittedLedger: The selected valid local ledger, or a pinned snapshot of it, contains no accepted transition; this is only a local statement.
outputs.UnknownCommitState: The carrier is absent, unreadable, malformed, unpinned, mismatched or otherwise insufficient for either positive classification.

relation_boundary: The snapshot builder validates SQLite state; the independent snapshot receiver checks only canonical JSON, byte and body digests, complete bindings, allowance arithmetic and stored-result structure. It does not open SQLite or rerun the original mathematical checker.
applicability: one trusted local single-slot ledger using the frozen ancestor schema
one canonical version-zero snapshot built after successful ledger validation
the receiver already possesses the intended request, candidate and snapshot byte pin
the declared finite byte, work, process and time limits hold
witness: The first bounded v1 campaign builds four snapshots over two distinct exact-rational decision families. Two pinned empty snapshots return ProvenUncommittedLedger and two pinned committed snapshots return StoredCommitted with the exact stored result.
counterexamples_and_refusals: a changed expected history returns UnknownCommitState
changed snapshot bytes under the old pin return UnknownCommitState
a malformed snapshot with its own matching pin returns UnknownCommitState
a wrong snapshot profile with its own matching pin returns UnknownCommitState
expansion_or_replay: Run the frozen campaign or invoke snapshot.py followed by receive.py in separate processes. Retain the complete request, canonical snapshot, receiver-selected byte pin, response, source ledger digest, commands and source fingerprints. Replaying this relation is not a new submission.
residuals: the builder shares Python, SQLite and the old validator with the writer
the pin has no authentication unless obtained through a separately trusted channel
a malicious builder can produce a self-consistent false snapshot
there is no power-loss, hostile replacement, external-action or distributed exactly-once model
local ledger emptiness does not prove that no external action occurred
the profile is external research, not a native Adva operation
benefit for a real human task is unmeasured
forbidden_conflations: snapshot consistency with independent arithmetic proof
StoredCommitted with permission to repeat the action
UnknownCommitState with failure or retry permission
a Proposed word with native communicate, accept, free, Close or Seal
finite receipt checks with arithmetic universality or M6 closure
